scope: 2019 and newer · under 20k miles · clean title · nationwide
title: What Each Car Has Been Through
lead: 25 720S listings under 20k miles on CARFAX; 7 coupes fit. Ranked by how the car has lived, not by price.
takeaway: My two cents: the 2022 at Chicago Motor Cars is the one to own (one owner, McLaren service every year). The 2020 Performance at McLaren Chicago is the smart money at $265,300 with a spotless record. Recent coupe sales cluster around $269,500 at low miles, so every ask above $270k should come down.
shift: classic.com, Mar 13, 2026. Looks low; may be a bid, not a sale
Coupe asks under 20k mi start at $230k; 720S Spider sales run about $25k above coupes
Ferrari of Central Florida 2019: CARFAX shows 20,556 mi, over the limit. Motor Cars of Chicago 2019 Gray #9935: 7 owners. McLaren North Jersey 2019: Canadian commercial use and a turbo replaced
sources: Listings and full CARFAX reports from carfax.com dealer listings (free reports), read Nov 7, 2026 in the built-in browser; Autotrader for European Exotic Center. Sold results from classic.com and Cars & Bids via Codex, Nov 7. Days listed from CARFAX first-seen dates. Window stickers: iPacket refused these VINs; Chicago Motor Cars says the 2022 comes with its original sticker.

cars.name: Chicago Motor Cars
cars.car: 2022 · Performance, Black / Black, lift, sport exhaust, B&W audio, red calipers, front PPF
cars.loc: Chicago Motor Cars, West Chicago, IL
cars.rep: No repairs reported. Washer fluid reservoir replaced (Dec 2025). No accidents, clean title.
tl: Sold new in Florida, McLaren Tampa Bay (Dimmitt) delivered it at 22 mi
Serviced every year at McLaren Tampa Bay: Jan 2023, Nov 2023, Dec 2024, Dec 2025
Traded at 8,872 mi, Motor Cars of Chicago listed it, then Chicago Motor Cars took title in July
Listed at Chicago Motor Cars, 8,879 mi. Listing says the original window sticker is included
cars.verdict: The cleanest coupe on the market. One owner, dealer-serviced every year, nothing but routine work. The newest car here, so it is also the priciest at $300,511. Ask for the window sticker PDF and push for $280k: the coupe sales below run $219k to $270k.
cars.msrpSrc: Dealer says the original window sticker comes with the car

rev.good: Same store that sold us the silver 650S talks (Mike, James); answers fast.
rev.bad: BBB D+ with complaints; Parin held hard at $169,800 on the 650S.

cars.name: McLaren Chicago
cars.rep: No repairs reported. Washer nozzle (2022), drain plug gasket at a 2026 PDI. No accidents, clean title.
tl: New car at Jaguar Aston Martin McLaren Palm Beach, sat unsold 14 months
Owner 1, California, bought at 517 mi. Serviced at Lamborghini Newport Beach 2022-23
Owner 2, Friendswood, Texas. Lamborghini Houston service Jan, Jun, Aug, Nov 2025
Lamborghini Dallas PDI, then McLaren Chicago listed it at 8,591 mi; inspected Oct 27
cars.verdict: Best value with a clean record. Two owners, dealer-serviced the whole way, no repairs, and it was registered new in 2022 so it lived a short life. At $265,300 it sits near the coupe sales median. A franchise McLaren store with 4.8 on CARFAX.

rev.good: Franchise McLaren dealer; 4.8 from 18 CARFAX reviews.

cars.name: Motor Cars of Chicago (Gray)
cars.loc: Motor Cars of Chicago, Joliet, IL
cars.rep: Window regulator replaced (2021), door latch replaced and computer reprogrammed (2022), intercooler serviced (2020). No accidents.
tl: Owner 2, Pelham, New Hampshire, 7 years, about 750 mi a year
Window regulator and door latch replaced, computer reprogrammed, all at McLaren Boston
McLaren Boston PDI and fluids at 4,676 mi, then sold to Motor Cars of Chicago
cars.verdict: Lowest miles of the clean cars, McLaren-serviced its whole life. The door hardware repairs are common 720S fixes, not red flags. Same Joliet dealer as the R8, Yelp 2.0.

rev.good: Huge exotic inventory; ships nationwide; same dealer as the R8 talks (Zach).
rev.bad: Yelp 2.0 from 56 reviews; follow-up and add-on complaints.

cars.name: Motor Cars of Chicago (Red)
cars.car: 2019 · Memphis Red / Black, carbon, Opti-Coat. Stock 11153
cars.loc: Motor Cars of Chicago, Joliet, IL
cars.rep: Windshield replaced (2020). Bought at a dealer auction Oct 16, 2026. No accidents.
tl: Owner 1, Casper, Wyoming. Aston Martin Denver service every year 2020-25
Sold at a dealer auction, then listed at Motor Cars of Chicago two days later
cars.verdict: Cheapest clean coupe. Six straight years of dealer service and one windshield, but it came through an auction last month and has the most miles. Good number to anchor a lowball on the others.

rev.good: Huge exotic inventory; ships nationwide; same dealer as the R8 talks (Zach).
rev.bad: Yelp 2.0 from 56 reviews; follow-up and add-on complaints.

cars.name: McLaren Scottsdale
cars.rep: No repairs reported. Two duplicate titles (2019, 2020). True360 inspection 2023: no prior damage.
tl: Delivered through BMW Mini of Sterling, Virginia
Owner 1, West Virginia. Duplicate title issued twice, 2019 and 2020
True360 inspection: no prior repairs or damage found
Owner 2, Arizona. McLaren Scottsdale service 2024, 2025, Oct 2026
Listed at McLaren Scottsdale, 1,899 mi, price not posted
cars.verdict: Practically a new car at 1,899 mi, McLaren-serviced. Ask why two duplicate titles were issued and get the number; expect it priced near $270k.

cars.name: Long Island Sports Cars
cars.car: 2021 · Performance, Red / Black, carbon ceramics, soft-close doors
cars.loc: Long Island Sports Cars, Roslyn, NY
cars.rep: No repairs reported, but no McLaren service on record: only inspections at a Ford store. No accidents.
tl: Offered new at Long Island Sports Cars, 953 mi
Only state inspections at Levittown Ford; no oil service shown
Back at Long Island Sports Cars, 8,795 mi
cars.verdict: One owner, newer car, thin paper. CARFAX shows no McLaren service in four years. Ask for receipts; without them it is worth less than the Chicago cars.

cars.name: Autopark Dallas
cars.car: 2019 · Luxury, Black / Black, carbon aero, lift, aftermarket valvetronic exhaust
cars.rep: Water pump and gasket, windshield and fuel filter replaced (May 2025), intercooler serviced, A/C recharge, PCV valve. Aftermarket exhaust.
tl: Delivered through Volvo Cars Palo Alto (McLaren SF), sat with 340 mi until 2020
Owner 1, Tyler, Texas. Owner 2 same city, 8 months
Water pump and gasket replaced, windshield, fuel filter, coolant at Lamborghini Houston
New owner reported in California while Autopark still lists it. Confirm it is still for sale
cars.verdict: Skip. Four owners, a water pump, an aftermarket exhaust, 228 days on the lot, and CARFAX shows a California sale in September.

cars.name: European Exotic Center
cars.car: 2019 · Onyx Black / Black Alcantara, carbon interior, forged wheels, sport exhaust, lift, PPF. Stock S03563
cars.loc: European Exotic Center, San Clemente, CA (18 mi)
cars.rep: No free CARFAX: Autotrader offers only a paid AutoCheck. Ask the dealer for the CARFAX.
tl: Listed on Autotrader, 5,505 mi, no dealer fees. History not read yet
cars.verdict: The local one. 18 miles from home, low miles, good spec. Get the CARFAX from the dealer before it can rank.

rev.good: Local: drive over and see it.
